module_summary: PTP hardware clock that advances ToD and relative timestamps via a 16-state sequencer time-sharing one registered 48-bit adder, serializes time-distribution messages through a shift register, and generates PPS.

anchors.name: update_state_reg
anchors.why: 16-state update sequencer stepping the shared adder through period, fns, rel, ToD and offset computations

anchors.name: adder_sum_reg
anchors.why: Shared 48-bit adder result written back into all timestamp registers

anchors.name: adder_busy_reg
anchors.why: Stalls the update FSM one cycle while the registered adder settles

anchors.name: adder_a_reg
anchors.why: Adder operand A, loaded per FSM state from timestamps or previous sum

anchors.name: adder_b_reg
anchors.why: Adder operand B: offsets, period, increments or +/-NS_PER_S; sign bit steers borrow check

anchors.name: adder_cout_reg
anchors.why: Adder carry used to detect ns borrow/overflow and choose second adjust

anchors.name: ts_tod_ns_reg
anchors.why: Time-of-day nanoseconds, incremented each update and wrapped at one second

anchors.name: ts_tod_s_reg
anchors.why: Time-of-day seconds, incremented or decremented on ns wrap

anchors.name: ts_rel_ns_reg
anchors.why: 48-bit relative timestamp in ns advanced by increment plus offset

anchors.name: ts_fns_reg
anchors.why: Fractional-ns accumulator whose carry yields the ns increment

anchors.name: ts_inc_ns_reg
anchors.why: Per-update ns increment held for ToD timestamp addition

anchors.name: ts_tod_offset_ns_reg
anchors.why: Computed ToD minus relative offset, sent in message 1

anchors.name: ts_tod_alt_offset_ns_reg
anchors.why: Alternate-second offset for next/previous second, sent in message 2

anchors.name: period_ns_reg
anchors.why: Programmable clock period ns/fns added each update and to PPS generator

anchors.name: drift_num_reg
anchors.why: Programmable drift numerator accumulated into fractional period correction

anchors.name: drift_denom_reg
anchors.why: Drift denominator reloading the drift interval counter

anchors.name: drift_cnt_reg
anchors.why: Down-counter over drift denominator generating drift apply pulses

anchors.name: drift_apply_reg
anchors.why: Pulse enabling drift numerator accumulation

anchors.name: drift_acc_reg
anchors.why: Accumulated drift correction fed into period computation

anchors.name: td_update_cnt_reg
anchors.why: 8-bit cadence counter whose overflow produces the update tick

anchors.name: td_update_reg
anchors.why: Periodic update tick starting FSM computation and loading TD message

anchors.name: td_msg_i_reg
anchors.why: Rotating message index selecting which ToD fields go into words 1-5

anchors.name: td_shift_reg
anchors.why: 238-bit message shift register serializing 14 words of time data

anchors.name: ptp_td_sdo
anchors.why: Serial time-distribution data output from shift register LSB

anchors.name: pps_gen_ns_reg
anchors.why: PPS phase accumulator; bit 30 clear triggers PPS delay load

anchors.name: pps_delay_reg
anchors.why: Delay counter aligning PPS pulse with serialized message

anchors.name: output_pps
anchors.why: Pulse-per-second output driven from pps_reg

anchors.name: output_pps_str
anchors.why: PPS stretched level output cleared in second half

anchors.name: input_ts_tod_valid
anchors.why: Valid for loading new ToD seconds/ns in idle state

anchors.name: input_ts_tod_ready
anchors.why: Ready pulse acknowledging ToD load

anchors.name: input_ts_rel_valid
anchors.why: Valid for loading new relative timestamp in idle state

anchors.name: input_ts_tod_offset_valid
anchors.why: Valid for applying ToD ns offset in FSM state 6

anchors.name: input_ts_rel_offset_valid
anchors.why: Valid for applying relative ns offset in FSM state 4

anchors.name: input_ts_offset_valid
anchors.why: Valid for fractional-ns offset added in first period step

anchors.name: input_period_valid
anchors.why: Loads new period ns/fns configuration

anchors.name: input_drift_valid
anchors.why: Loads new drift numerator/denominator configuration

groups.name: Update sequencer
groups.description: FSM sequencing timestamp updates on each update tick, stalled by adder busy

groups.name: Shared adder
groups.description: Registered 48-bit adder time-shared for all timestamp arithmetic

groups.name: Timestamp registers
groups.description: ToD seconds/ns, relative ns, fractional ns and computed offsets

groups.name: Period and drift
groups.description: Programmable period plus drift counter and accumulator correcting fractional ns

groups.name: TD message serializer
groups.description: Loads 14-word time message on update tick and shifts it out serially

groups.name: PPS generator
groups.description: Phase accumulator and delay counter producing aligned PPS pulse and strobe

groups.name: Input handshakes
groups.description: Valid/ready ports for timestamp set, offsets, period and drift
